limitations: HTTP marginal ns/byte is the original difference-of-page-service-cost statistic. It includes more than walker work; it is not RenderCounts ns/byte.
Tail acceptance uses the original ratio of mean p99 to mean p50. Every individual run is retained; 258-only run3 exceeds1.5. No independent per-sample gate was prescribed.
RenderCounts reports nodes/list iterations/output bytes/walk duration, not allocator call counts. Prior Criterion allocation evidence remains separately attributable to its own machine.
Same-binary distroless comparison is size and correctness only: no distroless throughput, memory or boot qualification.
Historical CI logs are unavailable from the CI backend after PR180 moved. Cleanup is supported by authenticated raw reports, successful workflow cleanup step and final empty scoped sweep.
Four trials ran sequentially once; sample spread and host metadata are retained. No comparison is made against other runner campaigns or older diagnostics.
